svg.text: euqalyptus docs · SDK reference / Qubit operations

div.p: Lifecycle of a LocalQubit as a left-to-right state machine:

ol.li: Apply gates: q.X(), q.H(), q.rot_X(...), … → each emits the corresponding qnet.* op.
Two-qubit interaction (optional): q.cnot(target) or q.cz(target) → emits qnet.cnot / qnet.cz.
Measure: m = q.measure() → emits qnet.measure, returns a Bit.
Free (optional): q.free() → no direct HIR op; surfaces during MIR lifecycle work.

div.p: Show the linearity arrow: after measure, the qubit value is consumed and must not be reused. Subsequent uses become a verifier error in qnet-check-linear.
